newsitem.title: USA: Alliance to receive milestone payment.
newsitem.headline: Alliance to receive milestone payment.

text.p: Alliance Pharmaceutical Corp Monday said it will receive $10 million under its license and supply agreements with Hoechst Marion Roussel for the worldwide development and commercialization of LiquiVent, an intrapulmonary drug under development for treating patients with acute respiratory failure.

In a statment, the company said the payment includes a $2.5 million milestone payment, a $5 million reimbursement for development expenses incurred during the current quarter, and the purchase of $2.5 million of LiquiVent, for use in future clinical trials.
Hoechst Marion Roussel is a unit of Hoechst AG.

The company and Hoechst Marion Roussel have agreed to modify the license agreement to adjust certain milestone payments and to temporarily revise the method for reimbursing expenses for portions of the development work in conjunction with the previously announced temporary interruption of the clinical developmental program.

Under the modified agreement, Alliance will conduct and be responsible for funding development activities in North America through December 1997. Hoechst Marion Roussel will reimburse Alliance for approved expenses for such activities in the form of milestone payments upon the occurrence of specified events subsequent to December 1997.

Hoechst Marion Roussel will be responsible for conducting and funding any activities outside North America for the balance of 1997. Beginning in January 1998, Hoechst Marion Roussel will resume funding for LiquiVent development expenses worldwide. The parties have agreed to establish a mechanism for Hoechst Marion Roussel to recoup certain development expenses if it terminates the license agreement prior to January 1998.
Alliance also announced that all outstanding shares of the Series C Preferred Stock, held solely by Hoechst Marion Roussel, converted into 345,327 shares of Alliance common stock, effective Monday.
